title: DashboardPersonalWork
wrapsNative: MonarchDashboardGrid (androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.grid.LazyVerticalGrid) of MonarchSectionCard and MonarchWidget sections with MonarchCheckboxRow, MonarchBadge, MonarchProgress and MonarchActivityTimeline
summary: The home screen of a person's own work ("My work"): today's tasks, what is assigned to them, their progress and recent activity, as sections of a MonarchDashboardGrid.
whenToUse: As the home screen of a work product (tasks, tickets, projects) that answers "what do I need to do?" for the signed-in person.
whenNotToUse: For a team's or a portfolio's figures use the DashboardPortfolio recipe or a KPI row with charts; for one list of tasks use a list screen.
api: MonarchDashboardGrid(items = sections, key = { it }, itemLabel = { it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) { section -> when (section) { "today" -> MonarchSectionCard(title = "Today", meta = date) { MonarchCheckboxRow(…); MonarchBadge(text = "Overdue", tone = MonarchTone.Danger) }; "assigned" -> MonarchWidget(title = "Assigned to you", onViewAll = …) { … }; "progress" -> MonarchWidget(title = "Progress") { MonarchProgress(progress = …, label = …) }; else -> MonarchWidget(title = "Recent activity", onViewAll = …) { MonarchActivityTimeline(events, modifier = Modifier.heightIn(max = …), groupByDay = false, density = MonarchActivityTimelineDensity.Compact) } } }

options.name: sections
options.description: The sections in order; leave out what the person has no data for. With onLayoutChange and editing the person can rearrange them.

options.name: today
options.description: Today's tasks as MonarchCheckboxRows, overdue first with a danger badge (see the TodayPanel recipe for the agenda).

options.name: assigned / due soon
options.description: Rows of the person's items with a status badge, and View all.

options.name: progress
options.description: Progress towards a goal or sprint, with the count in words.

options.name: activity
options.description: Recent events about the person's work (the ActivityWidget recipe).

options.name: MonarchWidget.state
options.description: Loading, Empty or Failed per section while its data loads or fails.

states.name: loading or failed section
states.description: MonarchWidget with state = Loading or Failed and onRetry, per section.

states.name: editing
states.description: MonarchDashboardGrid with editing = true shows arrange bars to move sections.

appearance: Widgets and section cards on the surface color with the subtle border, checkbox rows and badges in their own appearance, the progress bar in the accent color. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web DashboardPersonalWork is one server-safe template with a header (title, period, actions), a KPI row, an insight strip and named slots laid out in a responsive grid. On Android it is a recipe the app owns: MonarchDashboardGrid is the screen's scrolling list (one column on a phone, more from 1024dp, and rearrangeable with editing), and each section is a MonarchWidget or another Monarch part. The title and actions belong to the screen's TopAppBar; add a KPI row (MonarchStatCard in a FlowRow) as the first full-span item when the product has key figures. Lazy parts such as MonarchActivityTimeline get a bounded height inside a grid item. iOS has no entry yet.
accessibility: Each section's title is a heading, so TalkBack users can jump between sections.
Each task is one MonarchCheckboxRow with a 48dp row; overdue is a badge in words.
The progress bar reads its value and its label.
Statuses are badges in words, not colors alone.
edgeCases: Keep each section short and link to the full list with View all.
A lazy timeline inside a grid item needs a bounded height.
Leave out sections with no data instead of showing empty cards, or use MonarchWidgetState.Empty with a message.
